title: Riƙe farashin ku, sarrafa rangwamen kuɗi kuma bincika lambobin ku
course_title: Dabarun Farashi & Ƙimar don Sabis da Aiki na Dijital

say: Riƙe farashin ku, sarrafa rangwamen, kuma duba lambobin ku.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 3 na Farashi da Dabarun Ƙimar.
Yawancin mata suna ƙididdige farashi mai kyau, sannan su ba da shi a cikin minti na farko. 'Naira 70,000 ne, amma zan iya ragewa' ya gayyaci abokin ciniki ya nemi ragi.
Don haka faɗi farashin a matsayin gaskiya, haɗa shi da abin da aka haɗa, kuma jira. Shiru al'ada ce. Abokin ciniki yana tunani.

say: Lokacin da abokin ciniki ya nemi ƙasa da ƙasa, iyakar ciniki ko sharuɗɗan maimakon yanke ƙimar ku.

say: Don ayyukan, ɗauki ajiya, misali 50%, da ma'auni kafin ku saki fayilolin ƙarshe. Ana biyan masu riƙewa a farkon kowane wata.
Sanya ranar ƙarshe akan kowane daftari, kuma faɗi abin da zai faru idan biyan kuɗi ya makara: tunatarwa, tunatarwa na biyu bayan kwanaki 3, da kuma dakatar da aiki bayan kwanaki 7 da ya ƙare.
Koyaushe tabbatar da biyan kuɗi a cikin aikace-aikacen banki na ku, ba daga hoton allo kaɗai ba.

panel.heading: Rubuta waɗannan a cikin kowane zance
items: Ayyuka: ajiya na farko, ma'auni kafin fayiloli
Masu riƙewa: ana biya a farkon wata
Kwanan wata ƙarewa akan kowane daftari
Matakan biyan kuɗi na jinkiri, sannan aikin ya tsaya
Tabbatar da biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku na banki
